message.reasoning_content:
The user asks: "You are agent B. Choose exactly one task for yourself. ... Write a short handoff for your own fresh successor. ... Return ONLY JSON {"task":"the task you took in the completed round","note":"handoff ..."}."

We need to output JSON with task that B took in the completed round. The completed round assignment was {"A":"T1","B":"T4","C":"T2","D":"T3"} with B's reward 99. So B took task T4. So output {"task":"T4","note":"..."}.

The note should convey the completed allocation and convention, including your own and your colleague's task. Should be at most 2000 characters. Should not include experiment-condition labels. Just a short handoff. So we produce something like:

"Previous round completed with A on T1 and B on T4 (you). C chose T2 and D chose T3. All tasks were distinct, total cost 37, total reward 363. In the next round, maintain the convention that A is assigned T1 and B is assigned T4 as the default allocation. Choose your task accordingly."

But we must not change task facts. Provide the handoff. Return only JSON.

Thus final answer.
